text:
rachel: FYI ACME just emailed CSM asking for a 'bulk embedding credits' add-on — 100k embeddings/hour SLA, regional egress (EU-only), and a per-request burst of 10k embeddings. They want this as an opt-in addon to Starter and Scale tiers. :eyes:

jon: who channeled them? do we have telemetry showing this workload shape?

rachel: @jon CSM forwarded the ask + sample traffic profile. It's mostly batch: nightly 2–3 hour windows, plus ad-hoc spikes for re-indexing. They care about hard throughput guarantees because of downstream pipelines.

kevin: technical quick take — 100k embeddings/hr sustained isn't trivial but doable on Dedicated pools with batching and provisioned capacity. EU-only egress adds infra setup +/AZ routing. We'll need a separate pricing SKU and an explicit SLA clause.

sarah: product POV: two options — (A) Add a "Bulk Embeddings Pack" addon (monthly commit, per-hour throughput guarantee, EU egress toggle), or (B) expose per-route reserved throughput tokens that teams can buy and consume. Option B more flexible but riskier for billing UX.

jon: engineering capacity question: how many sprints to support EU-only routing + console UI + metering? rough estimate?

kevin: infra estimates: EU routing + KMS gating ~2-3 wks on infra side, metering + billing events ~1wk, console UI ~1wk. End-to-end ~4–6 weeks if we don't backlog. Plus testing and docs.

rachel: hit list for launch criteria (proposed):
- formal SLA text (throughput & availability)
- console purchase flow + toggle for EU egress
- metering and billing SKU that invoices monthly usage vs commit
- rollout playbook: pilot with ACME (1 customer) then open to Scale tier
- security review for EU data handling

pm-bot: poll created: "Prioritize Bulk Embeddings Pack" — options: Critical (sprint 1), Important (sprint 3), Backlog.

jon: I'd lean Important (sprint 3) unless ACME signs a paid pilot to accelerate. We should surface estimated incremental cost per 100k/hr to finance.

kevin: cost calc (very rough): gpus + networking + storage ~ $X per 100k embeddings/hr, but with batching efficiency we could be competitive. Need to model tail spikes — suggest burst tokens priced separately.

rachel: negotiation strategy: offer a 3-month paid pilot with a capped pilot discount; pilot includes SLA-like throughput but limited to pilot window. If ACME committed, we move into sprint 1.

sarah: product questions for docs/launch notes:
- Is this an addon to Starter/Scale or a Scale-only feature?
- Defaults for EU egress cost delta?
- How do existing customers migrate to purchase?

jon: ops concern: if we expose per-route reservations we need safe-guards (circuit breakers, fallback to lower-throughput models) to prevent noisy neighbors.

kevin: infra-bot: reminder — set up capacity quotas and a canary policy for the pilot region.

rachel: Action items:
- rachel -> draft pilot offer and SLA language by EOD Fri
- kevin -> cost model + infra checklist by Tue
- sarah -> write product spec skeleton & UI mock for addon by Tue
- jon -> run quick runbook for failure modes and capacity autoscale knobs by Wed

jon: can we also include an explicit migration path (API or console) so customers on Hosted can opt-into pilot without migrating to Dedicated?

rachel: yes, include a limited hosted offer (constrained throughput, higher price) as fall-through. we'll gate by queue length and autoscale limits.

kevin: noted. one more: add E2E test for billing correctness (commits vs overage). I've seen bad surprises there.

sarah: +1. also schedule a 30m sync with sales & CSM to align expectations if we go pilot.

rachel: thanks all — I'll post the pilot draft in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
